ingredientSections.heading: Vegetable Stuffed Roast Beef
items: Approximately 1.5kg Grass-fed Beef shoulder or round roast

methodSections.heading: Vegetable Stuffed Roast Beef
steps: Start by preparing the vegetables. Peel and trim the carrots and slice the peppers into thin strips. Season with a little olive oil, salt, pepper and fresh thyme. Set aside.

Using a sharp knife, cut into the beef along its side and carefully make a continuous cut leaving the meat to 'unroll' with a thickness of about 2-3cm (¾-1in). Take your time, making small cuts until you are confident. You could also ask your butcher if they could do it. You will be left with one large rectangle.
Rub the roast with a little olive oil, salt and pepper and position it in the centre of a large piece of parchment paper (tinfoil will work but is not optimal).
Place the vegetables lengthwise in its centre and fold the ends of the meat-rectangle over. Roll tightly so there is a center with vegetables and the meat covers the outside.
Wrap this tightly on all sides in the parchment and tie with twine to hold it together while baking. You may need an extra set of hands.

Put the package in a roasting pan with a little water and bake at 180°C (350°F) for about an hour. You can test the vegetables in the centre for tenderness by inserting a skewer into the package. Once they are tender, remove the roast from the oven and leave to rest for a few minutes before carefully unwrapping.
Carve no thinner than 2-3cm (1in) slices. Serve with mashed potatoes, salad and a little of the raspberry mustard (see previous page).
